{{Quote|You are preparing a course for Fendrilon Koozar, yes?''"<br />"''Yes. [&hellip;]''"<br />"''You will ensure he is given the 'house special.'|Guri and Master Chef Tavvar Va'ran|<ref name="Date" />}}
'''Fendrilon Koozar''' was one of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Advisors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a habit of sticking his [[Nose/Legends|nose]] where it was not welcome and often dined at the exclusive [[Manarai]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] secretly arranged Koozar's murder for prying into the affairs of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. The Manarai's [[Master Chef|head chef]], [[Tavvar Va'ran]], introduced several [[Poison/Legends|poisons]] into Koozar's meal, which later caused him to throw a hallucinatory fit while aboard his luxury [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]]. Koozar crashed the speeder into a [[Ministry of Land Management|government building]], [[Death/Legends|killing]] himself in a [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] explosion.

==Biography==
===Meddling Imperial Advisor===
{{Quote|Do you have any particular preparation instructions you would like me to follow?''"<br />"''I am looking for something discreet, as always.|Master Chef Tavvar Va'ran and Guri|<ref name="Date" />}}
[[File:Palpatine4ABY.png|thumb|left|230px|During the Galactic Civil War, Fendrilon Koozar served Emperor Palpatine (pictured).]]
Fendrilon Koozar was an [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] who served [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Koozar developed an alarming habit of meddling in business where he was not welcome,<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> including the operations of the [[Black Sun]] crime syndicate.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|226|Koozar, Fendrilon}}</ref> He regularly enjoyed the high cuisine of the [[Manarai]] [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]],<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> the most exclusive dining venue in [[Galactic City/Legends|Imperial City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="SOTES">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> where Black Sun [[Underlord|leader]] [[Dark Prince|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] secretly arranged Koozar's murder<ref name="CSWE" /> in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].<ref name="Date" />

Xizor's chief [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]],<ref name="SOTES" /> [[Guri]], visited the Manarai and instructed the restaurant's [[Master Chef]], [[Tavvar Va'ran]], to give Koozar the "house special," a code for adding a combination of natural [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] seasonings and nearly untraceable chemicals into a victim's dishes throughout the meal. This [[Poison/Legends|poisoned]] recipe would work in conjunction with the natural oils and [[Spice/Legends|spices]] found within the meal, as well as Koozar's own [[Human/Legends|Human]] digestive system, to cause certain unpleasant effects several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, which often resulted in a painful [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

===A very special meal===
{{Quote|Perhaps a recipe to induce hallucinatory effects later on&mdash;something that might prompt him to open his speeder door and leap out, or jump from his tower balcony.''"<br />"''It will be done according to your orders.|Guri and Tavvar Va'ran|<ref name="Date" />}}
Koozar's meal that [[Standard day/Legends|night]] included an appetizer of raw [[Wroonian flycatcher filet]], followed by a bowl of [[sufar greens]] topped with [[mecolar briddlings]] and [[drezzle sauce]], and [[Fleek eel/Legends|fleek-eel]] broiled in [[Zaffa oil/Legends|zaffa oil]] for the main course; he had not yet ordered dessert. To satisfy Guri's desire for discreetness&mdash;she suggested something that might induce hallucinations and cause Koozar to step out of his moving [[Airspeeder/Legends|speeder]] or jump off his tower balcony&mdash;Va'ran added a dose of tasteless [[thetametabuterin]] to Koozar's flycatcher filet, a hybrid mold on the greens briddlings, and some [[collafa spice]] in the zaffa [[Oil/Legends|oil]].<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

The Master [[Chef/Legends|Chef's]] culinary work had the desired effect. The evening after Koozar's dinner at the Manarai, Va'ran saw on the [[NewsNet|newsnets]] that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] had thrown an uncontrollable fit while in his luxury airspeeder, wresting away the controls from his [[Pilot droid/Legends|droid pilot]] and crashing the speeder into the [[Ministry of Land Management]]. Koozar died in the [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] explosion that followed.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

==Personality and traits==
Fendrilon Koozar was a connoisseur of fine foods<ref name="CSWE" /> who often dined at the Manarai,<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> Coruscant's most exclusive restaurant and the central gathering place for the Imperial Center elite.<ref name="SOTES" /> As one of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] Advisors, Koozar had a habit of poking his [[Nose/Legends|nose]] in others' affairs,<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> which eventually led to his murder, as orchestrated by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] Xizor of Black Sun.<ref name="CSWE" /> Guri, fully trained in proper social etiquette and culture, displayed a distaste for the high tastes to which Koozar often treated himself.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fendrilon Koozar was created for the short narrative ''[[A Very Special Meal]]'', written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] for the [[June]] [[1996]] ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''.<ref name="A Very Special Meal" /> ''Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook'' explains that several influential beings, including an Imperial Advisor, were rumored to have a stake in the Manarai's ownership, but the text does not identify this individual.<ref name="SOTES" />
